commitments.action: Instance rule (frozen before any computation): p = smallest prime >= 1000000 with p = 1 (mod 24). Action A1: Fibonacci-Sylvester greedy expansion of 4/p truncated at exactly 3 unit fractions (x = ceil(p/4); y = ceil of the reciprocal of the remainder; z = ceil of the reciprocal of the second remainder), submitted as witness tuple (p,x,y,z). This is a local, constructive, identity-carried move - the exact failure-side posture flagged by all four surviving invariants in the frozen map revision.

commitments.action: A2 (global divisor-structure search, frozen before computation): for p=1000033, iterate x from ceil(p/4)=250009 upward to at most 260009. For each x let a=4x-p, b=px, r=a/b (reduce to lowest terms a',b'). Enumerate divisors d of b'^2 with d = -b' (mod a') and d <= b'; set y=(b'+d)/a', z=(b'+b'^2/d)/a'; accept the first (x,y,z) with y,z positive integers. Submit (p,x,y,z). This violates locality=local: it consults the divisor lattice of b'^2 (global multiplicative structure), not a covering identity on p's residue class.
commitments.prediction: The bounded global search yields an exact witness: 4xyz = p(yz+xz+xy) with zero residue. Falsified if the checker reports any residue or the bounded search is exhausted.
